entries.title: The Pit: why a 50% loss needs +100%
entries.hook: Lose half. Now you must double just to break even.
entries.takeaway: A loss is measured from where you started, but the climb back is measured from what is left. So the climb is always the bigger percentage, and it grows faster the deeper the pit.

entries.title: 35% winners can beat 60% winners
entries.hook: 60% winners vs 35% winners. Guess who's losing.
entries.takeaway: How often you win is only half the math. A 60% win rate with small wins and big losses loses money; a 35% win rate with small losses and big wins makes it. The price of the second one is long losing streaks, so plan for them.
entries.question: Can a 35% win rate beat a 60% win rate?
